caption: The drawing depicts a single carved object resembling an acanthus leaf or a stylized, curved foliate ornament typical of classical architectural elements. The object is colored in muted tones of beige, light brown, and faint green, with shading to indicate depth and curvature. The form is asymmetrical, sweeping from left to right and curling into a spiral at the right end. Several carved, parallel grooves follow the general contour of the object, enhancing its three-dimensional appearance. Fine cracks and lines are visible across the surface of the object, contributing to a weathered or aged appearance. The object is centered on a plain, light-colored background with no other items or decorative details present.
title: Wood Carving - Scroll
